question: Did any ordinary local run in the three completed B development panels actually face a last affordable independent confirmation?
method: Take every feedback-local path, up to its first divergence. At each recorded decision use its own menu, fit balance, candidate registry and only the trials identified as already observed; use its recorded disjoint train-fold indices. Enable evidence protection with the opportunity reservation only after the observation on which it was made. Stop replay on a changed decision because later states would be counterfactual.
endpoints: original choice, proposed replacement and remaining resources
interpretation: Retrospective action replay. Development scores were already known before registration. No new experiment outcome or predictive benefit can be inferred for a changed action.
